review_type: Agent review of actual native captures and complete tasks, not a human usability study

criteria.clarity: Original identities and labels distinguish folders, references, selection, keyboard focus and disabled paging.
criteria.convenience: New items are selected and revealed; background commands, shortcuts and Restore desktop icons avoid terminal work.
criteria.user_friendliness: Hiding all icons leaves Start and restoration available; a fresh empty-desktop installation and disk restart exercise that route.
criteria.graphics: Centered native Inter captions, ellipsis, original vector art, theme-independent desktop ink and consistent focus cells.
criteria.readability: Two-line labels remain inside 112-pixel cells; full names are separate above the grid. Actual 150%/4K and 17 independent icon comparisons pass.

motion: Twelve complete viewport comparisons pass, including the corrected caption-capture hover case. Host observation timings are not FPS.
